reason: A read-only Git repository hygiene analyzer that reports merged or stale branches, oversized tracked files, untracked files, and uncommitted changes with cleanup suggestions.

summaries.zh: 只读检查 Git 仓库中的分支、文件和工作区状态，并生成卫生报告与清理建议。
summaries.en: A read-only Git repository inspector that reports branch, file, and worktree hygiene issues with cleanup suggestions.

capabilities: executes a whitelist of read-only git commands
inspects repository status, branches, tracked files, remotes, and object statistics
produces repository hygiene reports and cleanup suggestions
